title: InverseKinematicsNumerical fails for a robot whose links have no PDcontrol
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG11.8.20: InverseKinematicsNumerical.__init__ reads self.robot.links[i].PDcontrol to store it, but RobotLink sets the attribute only when PDcontrol is given, so a robot built without control raises AttributeError ('RobotLink' object has no attribute 'PDcontrol'); it also leaves the joint stiffness of the inverse kinematics and robot.gravity = [0,0,0] in the robot it is given. Found with the test model of #2259.
